reviews.text: 中奖没抽到我，差评。但游戏好玩，还给我我玩了几百小时demo，好评。

[h2]Mixed Feelings[/h2] After playing the demo multiple times, I was immediately hooked by the diversity and potential this game offered. During a previous Steam Next Fest, it stood out as one of the better action roguelikes among its peers. The variety in mechanics, weapon modifications, relics, characters, and the sheer potential for different builds made each run in the demo feel fresh and exciting, but more importantly very short, because it was unfinished at the time, giving only a taste of the action that I wanted more of. Fast forward to the full release, and things have become a bit more complicated. While that diversity is still technically present, the meta has shifted in a way that lowers it's diversity from some of the original appeal. If you get the best builds early by chance without knowing it. The game is a cake walk. If not, the challenge spikes of chapter 1 and 2 to 3 is kind of silly. The dominance of builds focused on stacking extra projectiles, especially with weapons like the Skorpian or Leaf Cutter, means that most successful runs revolve around maximizing fire rate and reload speed if you don'thave this, because there is no debuff for that besides increase spread which can be circumvented by a relic / attachment, INCREASING your damage tremendously to single targets. Other weapon modifications, outside of damage stacking besides growth with ignition effects, feel underwhelming by comparison. Example: I was able to stack over 200 ignition and growth with acid leaf cutter with massive acid relic scaling and x6-8 projectiles, with a condensed spread of 0%. Insane. If you stick to the meta, you can breeze through the game in about 50 minutes (most of which is spent fine-tuning your relics for peak damage AFTER you've failed a few times to unlock the best perks / talents). But if you try to play outside the meta, a single run can easily stretch to two or three hours, not because it is difficult, just kind of bullet sponge with elite modifiers and shields, which is far beyond what should be acceptable when it comes to a arena based action roguelike, that's a time commitment that slowly turns into a headache mixed with overwhelming amounts of fatigue. It felt unbalanced and, fully very much a chore. I can't speak much on the multiplayer aspect, as I played one full successful run, which took 4 hours of dying, to unlock the perks I wanted, because I would never find the right weapon, and I knew once I had unlocked those powerful perks and talents, each boss I was fighting for a few minutes would immediately be blown away. [h2]Issues[/h2] Unbalanced (you're either a god, or not) Very long runs. RNG (Synergy requirements) Atmosphere isn't there, the musics often empty. No end-game. One run is all you need. [h2]Conclusion[/h2] While there are bonus modifiers that ramp up the challenge and offer enticing perks, like starting a run with a powerful relic or finding even more elusive but powerful mythic weapons, these features don’t provide enough incentive to keep playing once you’ve beaten the game, unless you wanna try a different character, doing the same thing, in a slightly different way, might be better or might be worse, like playing a minion build, turret build, skill build, basic attack build, etc. The thrill of power and rare loot wears off quickly, and after just one, long and arduous victory, the motivation to continue fades almost entirely. I beat thengame with a singular rare weapon. Stacked with good relics. Without deeper progression systems, more game modes, diversity, atmosphere, music, or meaningful content to engage with, the replay value just isn’t strong enough to keep you coming back for more, at the very least for me, as the credits rolled. That isn't to say I didn't like it. I loved it initially, including the final fights animations, and generally all the bosses, if only they rotated their phases and mechnics a bit more sporatically, as it does grow stale after you memorize it. In the end I was thorn between. Hey! I'm having fun - Hey! Maybe... I should lay down for a bit, this is pretty damn excessively long for an action roguelike by industry standards. Hoo... which almost never happens to me as the headache kicked in. Personally, I would give it some time. It'll get better, support them if you want to now, but it's sure to burn you out. [i] Pass the Fear (PtF) combines the build variety and chaos of Enter the Gungeon and Gunfire Reborn, focusing on skill-based gameplay and really putting the "hell" in bullet hell when it comes to boss fights. [/i] [h1] 📝 Main Pros, Cons, and Suggestions, followed by the Review:[/h1] 🟩 Pros: + Large variety of items that truly define your build and how you play + Tight skill-based combat which really shines during the SHMUP-like chaos boss fights + Two tier meta progression, one at individual character level and the other applying globally + Weapons, parts, relics (items), fate cards, all the systems are brilliantly interconnected, adding a heap of depth and variety + Massive respect to the developers for the flawless English translations (something many Chinese games I've played on Steam struggle with) 🟥 Cons: - I’d have loved to see more weapon information - Lag and readability issues are a given with some builds - Acts 1 and 2 are far too easy, while 3 ramps up significantly 🏷️ Suggestions: ~ Local co-op ~ Leaderboards ~ Ultrawide support ~ Weapon effect transparency ~ Forge included during each shop visit ~ Adjust difficulties in acts 1 and 2, they're far too easy [h1] You’re Playing with Fate [/h1] Choose a character and begin your run, collecting weapons, parts, relics and fate (tarot) cards as you progress through the acts. It’s a familiar gameplay loop to most roguelite shooters. Where PtF separates itself is through its build variety and boss complexity. Basically, you can carry two weapons, each with different elements, unique effects, and variable modifiers (even if the base weapon is the same). Adding weapon parts grants passive bonuses and status effects, while relics provide additional bonuses and mechanics that further shape your build. Together, these systems highlight how massively synergies can impact your playstyle. The most broken build I had came from a tarot card that allowed my primary weapon to trigger my secondary weapon's effect. It transformed my piercing chain lightning pistol into a four-shot shotgun forged by Zeus himself, filling my screen with AOE lightning strikes. Moments like this are what made PtF feel rewarding - The further I progressed, the more the systems came together, and the more powerful I felt. Bosses are by far my highlight for PtF, feeling like a true 90s arcade machine bullet hell that’s trying to steal every last cent from my wallet. Bosses have telegraphed attacks and a crazy number of projectiles. It reminded me of Lost Ark mixed with the SHMUPs I grew up playing - It's chaos, and I'm all for it! If you like the genre, PtF is a no brainer. There’s a heap of depth and variety on offer and the gameplay is equal parts tight and chaotic. Pick it up, you won’t regret it! Buy this, it's amazing
依旧是我们喜闻乐见的地牢肉鸽射击游戏，体验非常扎实，在不同的对局中哪怕捡到了同把武器基于添加的不同武器部件也能打出相当差异化的效果，此外还有遗物和塔罗牌等随机要素可进一步丰富构筑，随着关卡的逐步推进胡局的爽感拉的很足，游戏很强调元素攻击，虽然单人仍可触发元素协同的效果，不过更建议多人游玩，希望在后续能更新本地合作的功能
最让我满意的一点是，游戏整体玩下来非常的完整，该有的流派、技能都不存在缺斤少两，发售即是完整版好吧！

This is the one I was waiting for. Absolutely incredible! The combat is very responsive, the characters are are very diverse and fun, the amount of disgustingly overpowered combos you can build towards is scratches that loot goblin itch that most roguelikes don't scratch, and something else... I froze at the 2nd to last boss. I let it sit for about 20 minutes and then force closed the game. I reopened and it dropped me in right at the boss room. This, this is good game design. I love you guys/girls. GG!

Higher difficulties don't seem that exciting either since it feels like the run is decided by your build, not your skills. I'll be refunding it, but still leaving a positive review because it's fun enough. My strongest enemy was the refund timer!

我也算是制作组半个老玩家吧，暖雪也玩了有80个小时了，这一作目前来看好玩是好玩的，但是问题也不少。 觉得双武器系统是没什么存在必要的，因为局内的资源其实只够养一把武器，第二把武器在大部分时候基本上是不怎么用，而且双武器联动的秘宝也不多，我觉得暖雪的四圣物的系统用在枪械上是一个道理，目前只有枪头这一个配件，说实话搭配感不是很强（武器随机词条在肉鸽游戏里真心不算好设计）。完全可以分成四个部件，枪头，弹夹枪托，瞄准镜分别负责不同的属性，完全摒弃随机词条。不过也可能会导致后期数值特别夸张，但目前来看游戏也是走的偏爽游的肉鸽，数值夸张问题也不大。 就算是只维持一个枪头配件，目前枪头只是纯粹的改数值，说实话跟秘宝的区别不是很大，就只是附带一个技能而已。如果可以加上一些机制，比如说改变射击方式从子弹转换成激光啊，或者炮弹啊之类的乐趣应该会上升不少。 以上为个人的小小想法，就算有不切实际的地方也请多多包涵，希望制作组越来越好，带来跟多的好游戏。

第二局就通关了，角色也全解锁了，其实不同角色差异化和单角色天赋选择搭配都很多，但是为什么遇到相同的武器秘宝配件不可以合成升级呢？ 我理解制作组担心会过于超标或者玩家的数值提升过快，但是这是你们要考虑怎么制衡的问题，经常遇到打完掉了一模一样的东西只能分解真的很扫兴，希望可以有额外的背包槽位不生效但是可以保存物品到休息点，通过类似禁锻的npc低价合成也可以 另外，前作暖雪的装备套装效果是游玩构筑中的一大乐趣目标，希望可以纳入后续的更新考量中，可以大大提高局内构筑多样性 ----------------------------------------------------------------- 7.24 谁想出来的三级畸变翻滚cd固定一秒的？怪物三倍血，开局还会出现后面章节敌人，没有找到传说核心坐牢到死 打一把出来就给那个b小队技能加点毛毛腿的提升 没有前作的开局自选圣物直接把平衡问题暴露完了 高难度简单粗暴塞后期怪，做游戏真简单啊 联机模式可以互相丢道具怕超模限制了一大堆道具的效果，那单人游玩的只能受着咯 而且可以预见的这个破联机模式做的也不行差评一堆 后续还要花大量产能时间优化 独狼肉鸽玩家只建议购入前作暖雪开爽 因为这个游戏只有前几局输了会突然提高高品质爆率让你以为很轻松，打两把刚好不能退款后面开局烂了死了掉落全变垃圾 全是小巧思

目前将近6个小时，我是53入手的因为我有失落城堡2；对得起这个价钱有开下一把的冲动，本质上BD游戏而非走位游戏；说个小巧思，当你前期死1~2次以后再开的时候会给你发紫色甚至橙色武器让你短暂开启扫图模式，第一次打到后面不会配BD导致没打过最终boss，一看时间2个h退款边缘，呵呵 但问题还是很多的，首先BGM烂完了后面直接关掉bgm玩，再有子弹碰撞没有反馈无论是被击中还是集中怪物，所谓的打击感来自于枪膛的声音也挺绷不住。 另一个问题是联机，好友码形同虚设搜索不到，加入没反应；但服务器是做了的因为我开公开房间可以找到加入，检索功能有问题。最后不知道是我2060显卡问题还是怎么的，开全屏帧数掉到个位目测；只要进图出怪我还没开炮呢帧数就被抽干，窗口模式瞬间正常，明显优化问题； 总的来说53块钱这个水平这个美术绝对合格的。
手感很好，我喜欢用冰系武器，冻住以后，扔一发炮弹直接解决小兵，BOSS技能多看看就能轻松躲过了，一局打下来也挺快的。流派还是挺多的，抽空研究下其他流派，后面等和朋友一块儿联机玩。还是玩肉鸽爽，忙碌中抽空就喜欢玩一把这种游戏。如果能有更多的栏位就更好了，现在十个有点不太够用，虽然可以分解，还是希望多来点能更爽。

Great game. The gear you pick up feels more meaningful than in a lot of other roguelites. I really enjoyed the art style as well. All around great game being held back by 2 things: No server browser or mm for co-op And that problem is compounded by how easy the game is. I finished the game on my 3rd and 4th run inside of 5 hours. I mean I guess there is hard mode but that really doesn't scratch the itch for me. If I had a reliable way to play co-op with strangers, this wouldn't be an issue for me. But the better part of $20 for only 5 hours is not a great value in my book. Either wait for a server browser update or a sale is what I wish I had done
